evidence.description: Report number 25-051985. Patrol unit responded to a reported burglary at a bank in Wanamingo, MN, on Monday, May 26, 2025.
Point of entry recorded as an attempt to saw into the ATM; no cash removed. Camera coverage at the premises was noted by the officer.

Police reportedly reviewed footage showing a person leaving a home, parking about three blocks from the bank, and leaving town shortly after the attempt. Report does not state the home's location, the person's description, or the footage source.
